verdicts.reason: Both use the same three-column banner and keep the brand, but the window is pushed to the centre, leaving big empty gaps on either side. In the original it sat tight against the headline. In both, the date and address lines on the right are tiny and hard to read at this height. A's window almost touches the top and bottom edges, and its headline is a little smaller. B's headline is slightly larger and its window has a little more breathing room, so B is marginally better.
